scripts.// Note: check:ports runs first and stops the start (&&) if 5173 or 5174 is already in use; predev (help manifest) runs beside the servers so one failure cannot block the others
scripts.// Logic: sketchpad.bat launches the environment; category lists and the Home list come from the folders (node/libraryIndex.mjs), so no manifest check runs at start-up; Utilities > Rebuild & Validate still runs node/maintain_manifests.mjs
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n SVC,VITE "npm run dev:svc" "npm run dev:vite"
scripts.dev:sketchpad: npm run check:ports && npm run predev && npm run dev:all
scripts.start:sketchpad: npm run check:ports && concurrently -n MAINT,DEV,OPEN "npm run predev" "npm run dev:all" "npm run open:sketchpad"
scripts.start:draw: concurrently -n VITE,OPEN "npm run dev:draw" "npm run open:draw"
scripts.lint:globals: eslint --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern ui draw classes drawRegistry utilities home gallery patterns help main.js drawMain.js
